paragraphs: Incorporated in April 1992, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is India’s largest coal producer in terms of production, primarily engaged in the mining and production of non-coking coal. The Company operates mainly in the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields in Odisha and produces various grades of coal, including washed and beneficiated coal, catering primarily to the power sector as well as industries such as cement, sponge iron, steel, aluminium and paper.

The Company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited and was established to enhance coal production and meet India’s growing energy requirements. Its operations include a network of opencast and underground mines, supported by coal handling plants, rapid loading systems, silos and coal evacuation infrastructure. As of June 30, 2026, the Company operated 17 mines, including 14 opencast mines and three underground mines.

Mahanadi Coalfields follows a highly mechanised mining model, with extensive deployment of surface miners, enabling efficient coal extraction while reducing the use of explosives, ground vibration, dust and noise. Its predominantly opencast mining operations, mechanisation and strategic location have supported efficient production and cost management.

The Company also operates the Ib Valley Coal Washery, which has a capacity of 10 million tonnes per annum and produces washed coal with lower ash content for high-efficiency power stations. Its coal evacuation network is supported by extensive railway connectivity, dedicated coal corridors, roads, rapid loading infrastructure and access to ports on India’s eastern coast.

The Company derives a significant portion of its revenue from long-term Fuel Supply Agreements (FSAs) and serves customers across multiple states in India, including major power utilities. It is also focused on research and development, operational efficiency, technological advancement and environmentally sustainable practices, including the installation of solar power projects.

As of June 30, 2026, Mahanadi Coalfields had 20,473 permanent employees, comprising executives, workmen, staff and supervisors across mining, engineering, excavation, finance, human resources, environment, marketing and other operational functions.
strengths: Strong financial performance and experienced management and workforce.
Well-positioned to benefit from India’s long-term demand for non-coking coal.
Large resource base and reserves supporting long-term non-coking coal production.
Low-cost and highly mechanised mining operations in strategically located coalfields.
Focus on research, technology, operational efficiency and sustainable mining practices.
Integrated coal evacuation infrastructure supported by strong rail and port connectivity.
Extensive deployment of surface miners and predominantly opencast mining operations.
India’s largest coal producer with significant coal reserves and long-term production potential.
Wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited, benefiting from its strategic support and resources.
Strong customer relationships with major power utilities and geographically diversified customer base.

faqs.question: How to apply in Mahanadi Coalfields IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Mahanadi Coalfields IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
